title: Off the Alphabet
description: caesar(text, shift) shifts every lowercase letter forward in the alphabet, wrapping around from z to a. Other characters stay the same.
hint: What comes after "z" in the character table?
explanation: Adding to the character code walks past "z" into punctuation (`{`, `|`, ...). Convert the letter to a 0-25 position, add the shift, wrap with `% 26`, and convert back.
